title: Planned move to a boarding facility in eastern New York
summary: Jordan tells of Planned move to a boarding facility in eastern New York, about 2010 at Eastern New York, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: was going to go to a facility in Eastern New York and I was going to live there full-time

plain: A man who gives only the name Jordan says that as a child he was taken into a secret government UFO program. He says that around 2010 he was told he would move to a facility in eastern New York and live there full-time. If true, it would mean a hidden program was gathering and housing children.
